remarks: Rental - Yearly or Flexible  Nestled in the sought-after Greens Farms neighborhood, this home offers the perfect blend of privacy, comfort, and convenience on a private 2-acre property.Enjoy easy access to the Greens Farms train station, beaches, schools, and all town amenities.Freshly repainted throughout and featuring newly refinished hardwood floors, the home feels bright, clean, and move-in ready.Inside, you'll find four spacious bedrooms, including a sun-filled primary suite with a walk-in closet and private bath.The eat-in kitchen boasts granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a generous dining area that opens to an oversized deck-perfect for entertaining or outdoor dining.A formal dining room adds elegance for gatherings, while the family room impresses with exposed beams, a wood-burning fireplace, and vaulted ceilings.The sunroom, with its soaring Palladian windows, offers a light-filled space for relaxing or working from home.Additional features include an upper-level laundry room and a partially finished lower level with ample storage space and walkout access to the backyard.A rare opportunity to enjoy the best of Greens Farms living-privacy, space, and timeless style-all in a prime Westport location.
